extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and the extensions page.

extDescription.message: Switches Markdown files to GitHub's rich diff in bulk when you open a pull request diff.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store.

alwaysRich.description: Label for the switch that turns on automatic switching.

pageDisplay.description: Label above the Source / Rich segmented control.

showingRich.description: Shown under the segmented control when every Markdown file is in rich diff.

showingSource.description: Shown under the segmented control when every Markdown file is in source diff.

showingMixed.description: Shown under the segmented control when the Markdown files are split between both.

notGitHub.description: Shown when the active tab is not on github.com.

notDiffPage.description: Shown when the active tab is on GitHub but not on a pull request diff.

needsReload.description: Shown on a diff page where the content script has not been injected yet.

noMarkdown.message: No Markdown files on this page
noMarkdown.description: Shown when the diff contains no Markdown files.

switchFailed.description: Shown when switching the display failed.
